scope.included: Performance/architecture campaign extensions and the highest-risk shared WebGL/WebGPU renderer changes currently in the working tree.
scope.excluded: An exhaustive mapping of every fork-added feature in FEATURE_INVENTORY.md. That larger traceability audit is queued as COV-P1-01.
scope.claimBoundary: A listed spec or probe in the matrix means that a relevant artifact exists; it does not imply semantic completeness. The executionCheckpoint separately records exact-current runs against one frozen bundle, but does not promote every discovery-time matrix row or certify the full fork.

reasons: The WebGPU directory has 227 JavaScript/TypeScript source modules and 91 WebGPU spec files with 1530 discovered Jasmine it() cases, but filenames and case counts do not establish source, branch, feature, or interaction coverage.
No enforced source-coverage threshold or complete feature-to-test traceability manifest was found.

Most WebGPU unit specs use mock devices, encoders, textures, and buffers; they cannot validate WGSL compilation, driver validation, attachment load/store behavior, pixels, GPU timing, or physical device-loss behavior.
The certifying visual baseline manifest contains zero entries, so the existing screenshot folders and ad hoc probes cannot currently certify historical WebGL or WebGPU behavior.

The exact-current broad WebGPU suite and bounded physical probes pass, but shared Renderer, DataSources, Scene, and full-engine gates exposed real regressions; several fork interactions remain mock-only or have no direct extension spec.
